title: GeoQuads — Daily
spoiler: Think seas, lines on the globe and lands cut off from home.
help: Find the 4 hidden categories. Each has 4 unique items.

groups.name: Coast on the Baltic Sea
groups.fact: The Baltic is one of the largest bodies of brackish water on Earth, because so little salty ocean water can flow in.

groups.name: Coast on the Black Sea
groups.fact: Deep water in the Black Sea has almost no oxygen, so ancient wooden shipwrecks survive there for thousands of years.

groups.name: Crossed by the Tropic of Cancer
groups.fact: The Tropic of Cancer, about 23.4° north, is the northernmost latitude where the Sun can be directly overhead.

groups.name: Has a part cut off from the rest of the country (exclave)
groups.fact: Nakhchivan, Cabinda, Temburong and Alaska are each cut off from their country's main territory by another country.
